name: whatsapp-skills
description: 11 skills that turn the context in your head into a ready-to-send WhatsApp message: 1:1 messages, replies, group and community announcements, invitations, promotions and order updates, status updates, channel posts, a formatter for Markdown or email text, masking of sensitive details, business and group profile setup, and chat catch-ups with minutes. Draft-only: nothing is sent for you.

interface.shortDescription: Give the context once, get the WhatsApp message to paste.
interface.longDescription: 11 skills for WhatsApp: 1:1 messages, replies, group and community announcements, invitations, promotions and order updates, status updates, channel posts, a Markdown-to-WhatsApp formatter, sensitive-detail masking, business and group profile setup, and chat catch-ups. You describe the situation in your own words; the skill returns the final text with correct WhatsApp formatting, exact dates and links, and the tone you asked for.
defaultPrompt: Write a WhatsApp message to my manager that I'm on leave tomorrow.
Announce a meeting change in my team's WhatsApp group.
Make a WhatsApp invite for my sister's wedding.
